import builtins
builtins.pl_fails('policy.load', 'the scene has no robot', path='${out}/rand.bin')

import builtins
f = builtins.pl_fails
f('policy.load', "cannot load the policy", path='${out}/missing.bin')
f('policy.load', "cannot load the policy", path='${out}/junk.bin')
f('policy.load', 'the policy observes 100 values; the contract builds 235', path='${out}/obs100.bin')
f('policy.load', 'the policy has 6 actions; the contract drives 12 joints', path='${out}/act6.bin')
f('policy.unload', '')
f('policy.enable', '', on=True)
s = app.policy.status()
assert not s['loaded'] and 'has 6 actions' in s['error'] and 'joints' not in s, s

import builtins, numpy as np
s = ${p0}
print('POLICY', {k: v for k, v in s.items() if k != 'joints'})
print('POLICY_JOINTS', [(j['name'], j['link']) for j in s['joints']])
assert s['loaded'] and s['on'] and s['device'] == 'gpu' and s['error'] == '' and s['path'].endswith('rand.bin'), s
assert s['robots'] == 1 and s['obs_dim'] == 235 and s['act_dim'] == 12 and s['decimation'] == 4 and s['rate_hz'] > 0.0, s
assert abs(s['action_scale'] - 0.25) < 1e-6, s
d = [0.1, 0.8, -1.5, -0.1, 0.8, -1.5, 0.1, 1.0, -1.5, -0.1, 1.0, -1.5]
assert np.allclose([j['default'] for j in s['joints']], d), s['joints']
for u, j in enumerate(s['joints']):
    assert j['name'].lower() == ('fl', 'fr', 'rl', 'rr')[u // 3] + '_' + ('hip', 'thigh', 'calf')[u % 3] + '_joint', (u, j)
builtins.pl_frames(5)
s = app.policy.status()
t = app.teleop.status()
assert np.allclose(s['command'], [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]) and t['controller'] and not t['on'], (s['command'], t)
builtins.pl_joints = s['joints']

import builtins, numpy as np
app.actions.run('sim.play')
builtins.pl_until_tick(builtins.pl_tick() + 200)
app.actions.run('sim.pause')
builtins.pl_frames(5)
tg = builtins.pl_targets()
dev = np.array([tg[j['link']] - j['default'] for j in builtins.pl_joints])
s = app.policy.status()
print('POLICY_RUN', np.round(dev, 4).tolist(), s['action_norm'])
assert np.all(np.abs(dev) <= 0.25 + 1e-5) and np.max(np.abs(dev)) > 1e-3, dev
assert 0.0 < s['action_norm'] <= np.sqrt(12.0) + 1e-4, s['action_norm']

import numpy as np
s = app.policy.status()
t = app.teleop.status()
e, w = (0.6 - 0.1) / 0.9, -(0.5 - 0.1) / 0.9
print('POLICY_CMD', s['command'], t['command'])
assert t['controller'] and np.allclose(t['command'], [e, 0.0, w], atol=1e-3), t
assert np.allclose(s['command'], t['command'], atol=1e-6), (s['command'], t['command'])

import builtins
app.actions.run('sim.play')
builtins.pl_run_for(9.0)
app.actions.run('sim.pause')
builtins.pl_frames(10)
s = app.policy.status()
assert s['action_norm'] > 0.0, s

import builtins, numpy as np
def zeroed():
    app.actions.run('robot.set_targets', targets={j['name']: 0.0 for j in builtins.pl_joints})
    builtins.pl_step(40)
    tg = builtins.pl_targets()
    return np.array([tg[j['link']] for j in builtins.pl_joints])
def policy_deviation():
    tg = builtins.pl_targets()
    return np.array([tg[j['link']] - j['default'] for j in builtins.pl_joints])
builtins.pl_zeroed, builtins.pl_deviation = zeroed, policy_deviation
s = app.policy.enable(False)
assert s['loaded'] and not s['on'], s
builtins.pl_frames(3)
assert not app.teleop.status()['controller']
assert np.allclose(zeroed(), 0.0), 'a stopped policy wrote the targets'
s = app.policy.enable()
assert s['on'], s
builtins.pl_frames(3)
assert app.teleop.status()['controller']
builtins.pl_step(40)
dev = policy_deviation()
print('POLICY_RESUMED', np.round(dev, 4).tolist())
assert np.all(np.abs(dev) <= 0.25 + 1e-5), dev

import builtins, numpy as np
s = app.policy.unload()
assert not s['loaded'] and s['path'] == '' and 'joints' not in s, s
builtins.pl_frames(3)
assert not app.teleop.status()['controller']
assert np.allclose(builtins.pl_zeroed(), 0.0), 'an unloaded policy wrote the targets'

import builtins, numpy as np
builtins.pl_step(40)
dev = builtins.pl_deviation()
print('POLICY_HOST', np.round(dev, 4).tolist())
assert np.all(np.abs(dev) <= 0.25 + 1e-5) and np.max(np.abs(dev)) > 1e-3, dev
